question: Should the OpenGrep security workflows adopt the proposed 120-second fetch retry window and 300-second whole-installer cap as their permanent fail-closed policy?
rationale: The implementation is correct, but selecting a hard deadline for a security-gating dependency is an operational security-policy choice that trades bounded execution for possible transient scan failures.

options.title: Adopt the proposed deadlines
options.body: Keep the current limits and accept a failed scan when the pinned installer cannot finish within the bounded budget.

options.title: Tune the deadline budget
options.body: Adjust the retry or whole-installer limits using historical runner latency before merging while preserving completed-download execution and an outer timeout.

recommendation.title: Adopt the proposed deadlines
recommendation.body: Keep the current limits and accept a failed scan when the pinned installer cannot finish within the bounded budget.
